nodes.label: EMS project context (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Names the stack (SvelteKit, TypeScript with Svelte 5 runes, Tailwind, shadcn-svelte, Drizzle ORM, MySQL 8.4, adapter-node), the offline LAN constraint, and which documents to read before which kind of work.

nodes.label: kebab-case files and conventional commit prefixes
nodes.rationale: Files and Svelte components use kebab-case; commits use a conventional prefix with a lowercase first letter; untracked or new files are feat:, never refactor:.

nodes.label: read the schema fresh before any query or migration
nodes.rationale: src/lib/server/db/schema/index.ts must be re-read before writing a query, migration or table change; never work from a remembered copy - the employee/user separation is exactly the kind of change that invalidates a remembered schema.
